relationships.subject: CXCL8 rs2227307
relationships.evidence_quote: patients carrying the G allele of SNP rs2227307 had more severe pain intensity

key_findings: Minor allele G of CXCL8 rs2227307 was an independent predictor of high pain intensity in TMD (OR 2.435), alongside age and female sex.
Polymorphisms did not predict TMDp presence; TNF rs1800629 showed no association.
